blocks.text: Group 16 ke elements Chalcogens kehlate hain kyun ke copper (Greek mein chalkos) ki zyada tar ores (khaam dhaat) oxides ya sulfides hoti hain. Is group mein oxygen aur sulphur non-metals hain, Se, Te aur Po metalloids hain, aur livermorium metal hai.
